tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Knitting Weaving and Crochet

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring knitting weaving and crochet. Annotate your process.
questions.correctAnswer: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to knitting weaving and crochet, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with knitting weaving and crochet. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.
questions.correctAnswer: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with knitting weaving and crochet. Which approaches were most successful and why?
questions.correctAnswer: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

tests.name: Extended Practice
tests.description: Self-marked extended answers on Knitting Weaving and Crochet

questions.question: Full-Mark Response Create samples using at least two construction techniques (knitting, weaving, crochet). Annotate each sample explaining the technique, its properties and how it could be developed in your project. <div class="
questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: demonstrate competent use of at least two construction techniques; show understanding of each technique's unique properties; annotate with precise specialist vocabulary (warp, weft, gauge, intarsia); evaluate which technique best serves their intention. Mark scheme: AO1 (develop through investigation) + AO2 (refine through experimentation) + AO3 (record ideas and observations) + AO4 (present personal response) = total marks
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
